get.summary: The single source of truth for money moved against a document. One row per settlement, including the settlement embedded in a sale or purchase at posting time. Every paid amount, outstanding balance and payment status is derived from these rows — never from sales.upfront_paid or purchases.upfront_paid, which are frozen posting-time snapshots.

get.summary: Read-only diagnostic: per business the caller may read, the ledger control account (1030 receivable / 2010 payable) beside the document-side live outstanding (document total minus COMPLETED, non-voided settlements), with the difference and an OK/ERROR status per side. Voided documents and voided settlements are excluded; posting-time snapshots are never read. SECURITY INVOKER and parameterless, so RLS decides which businesses it can see.

upfront_paid.description: Posting-time snapshot of what was paid when the bill was created. NOT a live balance: the settlement rows in public.payments (COMPLETED + POSTED, linked to this purchase) are the single source of truth, and every balance check on the server recomputes from them. Immutable after posting — guard_document_update (001) allows only status POSTED -> VOIDED to change.

payment_terms_days.description: Whole days of credit agreed when this document was posted. 0 means due immediately (cash terms). Documents posted before 015 record 0, which is how they were already aged.

due_date.description: The contractual due date: document date + payment_terms_days, enforced by constraint. Aging reads THIS column. It is metadata about when payment is expected and changes no amount, journal line or balance.
